name: Alachua County, FL
findings: Alachua County has 1,100 nonprofit organizations. 416 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 326 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Alachua County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
47% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Few social and fraternal organizations list public events
observations.text: 19 social and fraternal organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 40 would.

confidence.text: Based on 40 organizations here; 59% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for public events through social and fraternal groups? Where else does that happen?
